1.title: 概覽
content: 總是熱衷於找樂子並渴望製造混亂的 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加，是一座會移動的砲塔，他能衝撞敵人並用雙持機關槍將其掃蕩殆盡。如果你想在正面承受所有敵方攻擊的同時，還能對著危險大笑，那麼 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加就是最適合你的坦克。透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士（Berserker）被動技能以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）所產生的額外生命值，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加輸出的傷害往往超過敵人所能承受的極限，同時他的治療速度也快到讓敵人無法將他擊殺。

他是終極的坦克決鬥者，在 1 對 1 的情況下能戰勝其他所有坦克。如果對方的坦克玩家不懂得如何反制他，那麼進行一場 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的鏡像對決將是他們生存的唯一希望。即便面對體型嬌小且機動性高的目標，只要玩家槍法精準，就能充分利用「槍槍（Gunny）」與「恰恰（Cha-cha）」之間的切換。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加喜歡緊貼敵方坦克，在那裡他可以站穩腳步並同時扣下兩把槍的扳機。雖然他無法追擊高處的敵人，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）讓他能夠在平坦的地形上稱霸全場。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 集中火力攻擊敵方坦克。雙管機槍是擊潰坦克的完美武器。試著讓敵方坦克保持在近距離，如果他們試圖逃跑，就追擊他們。

* 不要總是使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)強行衝鋒（Overrun）來進行強勢開戰；試著以擊倒對手為目標。透過在衝鋒途中取消技能來靈活應變，留在隊伍身邊並誘騙敵方交出冷卻技能。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)困獸鬥（Cage Fight）會封鎖所有位移技能，因此請專注於困住高機動性的英雄。

1.1.2.title: 對抗策略
content: * 保留你的傷害減免或機動性技能，以防止他在 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）期間對你造成傷害。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）期間無法被阻擋。請站在他衝鋒範圍之外，或準備好閃避他。

* 當他準備好使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)困獸鬥（Cage Fight）時，要麼分散站位以免被困住，要麼讓所有人進入範圍內，這樣你和你的隊伍才能互相協助以在絕招中存活。

2.title: 優缺點總結
content: * 對抗坦克表現優異
* 具備自我維持能力
* 免疫控場效果
* 需要透過造成傷害來發揮作用
* 缺乏垂直機動性
* 容易被對手忽視

3.1.1.title: 坦克剋星
content: 沒有坦克會想與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加單挑。對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的最佳坦克人選，是那些能在 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）期間減輕他傷害的英雄。沒有任何坦克能單憑一己之力在傷害輸出或續航力上勝過他。當敵方坦克表現強勢時，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加能徹底壓制他們。

3.1.2.title: 自我維持
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)Berserker passive constantly grants overhealth from critical hits and burning targets. ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive’s life steal and damage reduction make you nearly unkillable for 3 seconds. Although he takes a lot of damage, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga has strong self-agency in managing his health pool.

3.1.3.title: 控場免疫
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)橫衝直撞（Overrun）是唯一能讓你完全無法被阻擋，甚至無法被駭入的坦克技能。你可以抓準時機使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)橫衝直撞（Overrun）來反制敵方的暈眩效果，並中斷某些位移技能。

3.2.1.title: 依賴造成傷害來生存
content: 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的治療效果取決於所造成的傷害以及能否點燃敵人，因此能夠減免傷害或賦予無敵狀態的技能會對他造成反制。面對擁有屏障或移動速度快且體型小的英雄隊伍時，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加整體的傷害輸出會降低，這也意味著他的生存能力會隨之下降。

3.2.2.title: 缺乏垂直機動性
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）可以用來獲得不錯的水平機動性，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）無法處理位於高處的敵人。他雖然可以射擊這些敵人，但由於同時使用兩把機關槍時子彈擴散範圍極大，因此被迫只能使用單把機關槍進行射擊。

3.2.3.title: 容易閃避
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的移動方式非常線性。![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）的路徑只能進行小幅度的調整，而且當他同時發射兩把機關槍時，移動速度會變得極慢。這些特性使他很容易被閃避，考慮到他最強的能力持續時間僅有短短的 3 秒，這對他來說是個嚴重的問題。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：燃燒機槍（Incendiary Chaingun）
content: 燃燒機槍（Incendiary Chaingun）的使用技巧
* 遠程消耗
* 當目標距離你超過 10 公尺，或是目標體型非常小時，你應該先用「Gunny」進行射擊，直到將其點燃為止。
* 對抗飛行單位
* 儘管當飛行單位距離較遠時，傷害衰減會變得相當嚴重，但你極高的射速與精準度，使你非常擅長應對飛行單位。
* 一旦你點燃了他們，他們就必須撤退到掩體後方，因為死亡的威脅會變得過高。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：揮發性鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）
content: 揮發性鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）的使用技巧
* 自動暴擊
* 射擊「恰恰（Cha-cha）」的重點在於對燃燒中的敵人造成自動暴擊。這是免費的雙倍傷害與治療量。
* 當燃燒效果結束後，請切換回「剛尼（Gunny）」。
* 隊友的燃燒效果

* 揮發性鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）可以與隊友的燃燒效果產生連動，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/954ef74e420324bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftorbjorn.png)托比昂（Torbjörn）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/6db02d49ff2c55df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmolten-core.png)熔火核心（Molten Core）。

4.3.title: 槍槍與恰恰（同時開火）
content: **槍槍與恰恰的使用技巧**
* 僅限近距離使用
* 同時使用兩把機槍會大幅增加子彈擴散。因此，只有在目標非常靠近時才同時使用兩把槍。
* 傷害會加倍，且如果目標無法使用護盾或淨化技能，你可以讓他們持續處於燃燒狀態。
* 坦克剋星

* 槍槍與恰恰讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加成為名副其實的坦克剋星。坦克巨大的體型與高生命值使他們成為完美的目標。如果敵方坦克讓你保持近距離並持續射擊，這就是你獲勝所需做的全部。
* 移動速度

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加在同時使用兩把機槍時，移動速度會變得極慢。敵人可以透過護盾、走位或繞過掩體來避開你。每當這種情況發生時，你需要切換單槍與雙槍模式，以確保目標維持在射程範圍內。

4.4.title: [SHIFT]：衝鋒（Overrun）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）的使用技巧**
* 擊倒

* * 成功擊倒是![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）的最佳用途，因為擊倒造成的傷害與控制時間通常能轉化為一次快速的擊殺。
* 無法阻擋

* * 由於![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）期間不會受到控場效果（CC）或駭入影響，你可以刻意利用此特性來反制敵方的控場技能。
* 他在啟動技能的短暫前搖動畫期間仍可能被暈眩，因此在某些情況下，你需要預判敵方技能的使用時機。
* 取消與繞圈跑法

* * 你不需要每次使用![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）都執著於撞擊敵人。那樣只會變成送頭並讓隊友感到挫折。

* 相反地，應利用![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）帶來的威脅與壓力來爭奪空間，而不必強行撞擊。
* 你可以選擇取消衝鋒，或是持續奔跑並繞回己方隊伍身邊。
* 誘騙敵方冷卻時間

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）的冷卻時間非常短，僅有 5 秒。幾乎所有其他技能的冷卻時間都比它長，因此如果敵人為了反制而對![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）交出了技能，你就能用下一次的![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）來懲罰他們。

4.5.title: [E]：心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）使用技巧
* 管理護甲

* * 理想情況下，你應該在還有護甲值時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），以最大化傷害減免效果。

* 此外，當 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）結束時，如果你已經沒有護甲，就需要撤退並尋求治療。
* 等待敵方坦克減傷技能結束

* * 僅 3 秒的持續時間加上 12 秒的長冷卻時間，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）很容易被浪費。

* 追蹤敵方坦克是否還有減傷技能可用，例如滿血的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）護盾，或是 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）。他們可以輕易吸收你在心臟過載期間輸出的所有傷害，進而讓你無法獲得任何生命竊取效果。
* 隊友治療

* * 雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）不再賦予隊友傷害減免，但它仍然能為他們提供生命竊取效果。

* 當附近的隊友生命值偏低且正在與敵人交戰時，你通常可以透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）來拯救他們。

4.6.title: （被動技能）：狂戰士
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士的遊玩訣竅
* 保持戰火延燒

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加在攻擊燃燒中的敵人時，造成的傷害更高且自我治療速度更快，因此在使用次要攻擊之前，應始終先用主要攻擊點燃敵人。
* 在近距離時，同時發射兩把槍永遠是最佳選擇。

* 燃燒機關槍可以對敵人造成爆頭傷害。其實你不需要等到目標燃燒，就能從 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士中獲得增益。

4.7.title: 絕招：牢籠格鬥
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠格鬥的技巧**
* 孤立敵人

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠格鬥的最佳用法是將一到兩名敵人困在你的巨大屏障內。他們會與隊友隔絕，而你的隊伍其餘成員可以安全地集中火力消滅被困住的敵人。
* 困住高機動性敵人

* * 將那些不斷跑得比你快的討厭英雄鎖在籠子裡來對付他們。像 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王這樣的敵人，在 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠格鬥中甚至無法使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳或 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)裂地重拳。
* 牢籠格鬥的反制手段

* * 隨時留意哪些敵方英雄擁有反制技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)織命的 ![](/data/assets/guide/70bdaf439d6cdcdd.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flife-grip.png)生命之握。在發動你的絕招前，請確保這些技能近期已被使用過。

* 當敵人使用像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖這類絕招來反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠格鬥時，最好取消該技能並使用橫衝直撞（Overrun）撤離。
* 人數優勢

* * 即使在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠格鬥時，你仍應確保隊伍擁有數量優勢。如果戰鬥中只剩下你自己和另一名隊友，困住敵方全隊 5 人反而會適得其反。

5.1.1.title: 動能彈帶（Kinetic Bandolier）
5.1.1.description: 衝鋒（Overrun）在蓄力期間的第一秒內最多可裝填 150 發彈藥。
content: * 小眾用途

* 在大多數彈藥耗盡的情況下，你通常也已經使用了 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），因此沒有足夠的生命值能直接衝向敵人並持續進攻。
* 此外，在這些情況下，你通常也不會跑完完整距離，因此無法獲得最多 150 發的彈藥裝填量。
* 減少空窗期

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）的裝填動畫比大多數英雄長得多，因此縮短裝填時間非常有益。
* 在面對消耗型與機動型陣容時很有用，因為你通常會花費較多時間進行消耗，然後突然需要衝入戰場。

5.1.2.title: 縱火狂（Pyromaniac）
5.1.2.description: 使用燃燒連發機槍（Incendiary Chaingun）點燃敵人可獲得 50 點超量生命值。
content: * 每當你點燃一名敵人時，會立即獲得少量的瞬間超量生命值。這對於生存能力很有幫助，且在必須採取較被動的打法時效果最佳。

5.2.1.title: 烈焰行者（Firewalker）
5.2.1.description: 衝鋒（Overrun）會點燃被擊中的敵人。
content: * 最佳主要特殊能力（major perks）

* 被點燃的敵人每秒會受到 15 點傷害，且能立即被恰恰（Cha-Cha）自動暴擊。由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在衝鋒（Overrun）期間無法被阻擋，他可以輕鬆地在每次使用時點燃多名敵人。
* 爆發傷害
* 猛擊敵人，他們會立即被點燃。如果你精準命中他們的頭部，甚至能從猛擊的暴擊中獲得治療。此外，你處理傷害的速度會更快，因為你不需要花時間在進行自動暴擊前，先用主要攻擊點燃他們。

5.2.2.title: 戰鬥燃料
5.2.2.description: 爆擊會使莫加在下次使用「心臟過載」時獲得 3 點臨時額外生命值，最多可累積至 150 點額外生命值。
content: * 不需要額外的額外生命值

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加能治療自己並減免大量傷害，以至於你在「心臟過載」期間根本不會注意到那 100 點額外的額外生命值。
* 再者，你需要在每次使用之間命中 50 次爆擊？實際上，你每次使用「心臟過載」時，平均大概只會獲得 50-60 點額外生命值。
* 對抗治療無效與傷害減免的軟制衡

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)「戰鬥燃料」在面對擁有治療無效技能的對手（例如安娜的生化手榴彈），或是能抵銷你整個「心臟過載」持續時間的坦克時會很有用。理論上，這些額外的額外生命值能讓你保住性命。
* 依然建議優先選擇「火行者」。

6.title: 地圖
content: 最適合 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的地圖通常擁有範圍較小但開放的目標區域。如果目標點被過多的天然掩體分割，敵方就能輕易地繞過他，因為他在雙持機關槍射擊時移動速度非常緩慢。其他戰士無法與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加正面對決，因此他在那些會將隊伍拉入近距離戰鬥的目標點上表現優異。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加最難發揮的地圖是那些擁有大量高台、且適合機動型陣容發揮的地圖。他缺乏垂直移動能力，因此當敵人逃往他無法觸及的高台時，![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）幾乎無法發揮價值。同樣的情況也適用於擁有廣闊開放區域的地圖，敵方可以在這些地方與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加保持距離。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: Team comps built around ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga can support his all-out aggressive plays. ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga gets hard-focused by the enemy. Outside of a few seconds of ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive's damage reduction, he has no protection from damage. Due to this, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga requires a lot of team resources to be allocated to him, so he works best with heroes who are self-sufficient. Allies also need to be able to quickly react to ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's Overrun since he sometimes uses it to bait, and sometimes goes deep for a hard engage. Lastly, the best teammates position themselves somewhat close to ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, within the 10m range.

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人搭配
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西
* 雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)莫加沒有護盾能讓 [[__OWH_IMG_2__]]艾西躲在後面，但他的存在會吸引敵方隊伍的全部注意力，這為 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]艾西創造了狙擊與投擲 [[__OWH_IMG_4__]]炸藥（Dynamite）的空檔。[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]炸藥（Dynamite）造成的燃燒效果也會觸發機關槍的自動爆擊。這種組合對付脆皮英雄特別有效，因為 [[__OWH_IMG_6__]]炸藥（Dynamite）的高爆發傷害，結合 [[__OWH_IMG_7__]]莫加的爆擊，讓敵人極難存活。用 [[__OWH_IMG_8__]]炸藥（Dynamite）擊中敵方輔助英雄會迫使他們交出治療冷卻技能，並削減他們坦克英雄的續航力。

* Although ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga doesn’t have a shield for ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe to hide behind, his presence demands the full attention of the enemy team, which creates an opening for ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe to snipe and throw ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite. The burning of ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite also triggers Volatile Chaingun’s auto-crits. This combo is especially good against squishies because the massive burst damage of ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite, combined with critical hits from ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, is very difficult for an enemy to survive. Hitting enemy Supports with ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite forces out healing cooldowns and takes away sustain from their Tank.

![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)霧子
* 擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)莫加最簡單的方法，就是利用像是 [[__OWH_IMG_2__]]生化手榴彈（Biotic Grenade）或 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]狂暴（Rampage）這類技能對他施加禁止治療的負面效果。[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]莫加主要依賴生命竊取來生存，因此如果他中了禁止治療效果，除非能使用 [[__OWH_IMG_5__]]衝鋒（Overrun）快速逃脫，否則必死無疑。[[__OWH_IMG_6__]]保護鈴（Protection Suzu）是清除 [[__OWH_IMG_7__]]莫加身上禁止治療效果並同時給予他瞬間治療的最佳技能。除了清除負面效果外，處於 [[__OWH_IMG_8__]]莫加在狐狸衝刺（Kitsune Rush）狀態下簡直能消滅所有敵人。[[__OWH_IMG_9__]]霧子本身也能造成不錯的傷害，從而受益於 [[__OWH_IMG_10__]]心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），這點與織命不同，後者是另一位擁有清除負面效果技能的輔助英雄。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga spends a lot of time dueling the enemy Tank in battles that are largely determined by sustain. Because he is a slow and huge bullet sponge, but he also deals high damage, fights are determined by which Tank receives more healing. ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper's flank playstyle is great for harassing or assassinating the enemy’s Supports, which greatly helps ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga win the Tank duel. Additionally, when ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper is frontlining with ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, the extra lifesteal of ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrivemakes them an unkillable wall of damage for 3 whole seconds.
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

* The easiest way to kill ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga is to apply an anti-heal debuff to him with an ability like ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)Biotic Grenade or ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)Rampage. ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga primarily relies on lifesteal to survive, so if he gets hit with an anti-heal, he dies unless he can use ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun to escape quickly. ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu is the best ability to cleanse ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga of anti-heal effects and simultaneously grant him a burst of healing. On top of the cleanse, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga in Kitsune Rush just deletes enemies. ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko also deals decent damage to benefit from the ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive, unlike Lifeweaving, who is the only other Support with a cleanse.

8.title: 如何反制
content: 目前為止 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加最重要的技能是 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）。無論你使用哪位英雄，反制他的關鍵在於抵銷心臟過載的價值。

你可以透過保留傷害減免技能，在他開啟技能期間進行格擋（例如：![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）、![](/data/assets/guide/1858a99948e6d377.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-shield.png)屏障護盾（Barrier Shield）、![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)格擋（Deflect）），或者在他發光時使用位移技能逃離（例如：![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)消散（Fade）、![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）、![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)教練槍（Coach Gun））。

另一件你需要注意的事是 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒踐踏（Overrun）。首先，不要被撞到。請務必保留一個位移技能來閃避他，或是待在掩體附近，以便隨時移動離開他的路徑。此外，他的衝鋒冷卻時間非常短，所以請隨時保持警覺，不要因為沒意識到自己在他衝鋒範圍內而措手不及。

* 當你想要徹底壓制他時，請找一位 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜來對他施加禁療效果，並找一位 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子來淨化被燃燒的隊友。
